answer: Two jurors re-execute each task, and divergence above 2 percent slashes both stakes. Quorum is 3 of 5, and any identity-link attempt resets both accounts to zero standing. Cost to run 1,000 fakes: 1,000 bonds at 500 POA, 2,000 re-executions, 3 signatures per payout, plus a 40-epoch vest on the kernel rewards. Honest cost per task: 1 bond, 1 execution, 0 resets. The bridge between the curves is 500 POA per seat, and the tide of clones loses money at every crossing.
